why: The welcome page (Rejsekort's start, signed out), at its top: the app's logo band, its illustration, then Continue, a white pill the app fills, over How to travel with the app, words it draws without a fill that scroll the page down to its guide. Plain, the two are items of the page's list; here Continue is the screen's primary action and How to travel with the app the action beside it, each across the bar of actions on a line of its own, stacked as the app stacks them. The page's list stays, empty, so a device can still scroll down to the guide. The logo carries no words of Rejsekort's own (its description names Fairtiq), so the screen has no title and a device names it by the app.

why: The welcome page scrolled down to its guide, How to travel with the app: four sections, each a headline the app draws bold and larger than its body text over a few lines of text, beside an illustration (left out, as it has no words). Its Continue at the end of the guide, a charcoal pill the app fills, is the screen's primary action, across the bar of actions.
